measure: scripts/ring_measure.py: share of the band 2..9 pt outside the app's own ring rect (OMX POINT / OMX RING ring=), rounded as mojoui.pointer rounds it (radius min(w/2, h/2, 14)), that is ring-teal in the frame and not in the same screen once the ring has faded; control = the faded frame's own teal share in that band
approved: owner, 2026-11-20 (replaces goal 77 M3's fixed 14 px square band share > 0.05 and M4's whole-page 150 teal-pixel count)
floor_rule: about half the lowest stored passing share (0.274)

negative_controls.faded frame (the ring gone, same screen): 0.0 in every stored and judged frame; > 0.04 fails the check (the measure can't see the ring there)

limits: the floor rests on one stored GTK run (four sizes and schemes of a Word card); the M3 numbers are this measure's own first run, a cross-check, not an independent calibration
